name: Plans library
annotation: Ongoing plan management surface (distinct from the onboarding summary): one Active-plan hero with a milestone spine and honest next step, one opt-in CIA adjustment with evidence, four-way status tabs, and a dense scannable plan shelf with domain, source, and premium-lock honesty. One BtnPrimary commitment CTA in the hero; PaywallLock never dead-ends the locked template.
belowFold: High motivation tier: filters row (domain, duration) above the plan shelf
High motivation tier: plan history + evidence chips per PlanCard
High motivation tier: completed-plan analytics summary card
trustControls: ChipProvenance "via training plan sync" required beside the active-plan next step; stale completion sync shows low-confidence "estimated · low confidence", never a fabricated percentage
ChipProvenance "via sleep + training plan" required beneath every CIA adjustment suggestion — never a hard claim without evidence, and never auto-applied without opt-in
Every PlanCard row carries a real source ("via CIA", "you saved", "imported") or shows honest-null; missing source never renders blank

PaywallLock on "Budget cleanup" is a blurred real-layout preview + single BtnPrimary "Unlock with premium", never a dead end; personalized insight stays hidden until both consent and entitlement are granted
Honest-null empty state "No active plan yet — start plan from a mission or ask CIA to draft one" replaces the hero when no plan is active, never a blank card
CIA plan memory exposes edit, pause, stop, archive, delete, export, share, and revoke controls; accountability sharing requires explicit audience selection and links to /contracts
All interactive targets — draft, filter, tabs, PlanCard rows, Resume/Adjust CTAs, and Unlock — are 44px minimum
notes: Skeleton: hero timeline, tabs, and 3 plan-shelf rows shimmer in final geometry (--surface-3 sweep). Empty (no active plan): hero region replaces with EmptyState — Display-small "No active plan yet." Body-light "Start plan from a mission or ask CIA to draft one." BtnPrimary "Ask CIA to draft a plan." Error: cached active plan and plan-shelf remain visible; OfflineBanner/SyncStatus names the failed source, e.g. "sync failed — training plan, last synced 2h ago" with BtnSecondary retry. Success: completing a milestone flashes the ActivePlanPath segment green (glow-done) and the ProgressBar sweeps to the new percentage. Disabled: draft, filter, resume, adjust, tab, and unlock controls dim to 40% opacity when entitlement, consent, or connectivity blocks them — never silently hidden. Motion: ActivePlanPath draws left-to-right from start to current week on load; swipe right on the hero completes the next milestone; swipe left on any PlanCard reveals Edit / Pause / Share / Archive / Delete, destructive actions (Delete, Archive) require confirmation; SegmentedTabs slide 150ms, list crossfades; reduced motion collapses all of the above to instant end-states. Consent/safety: CIA plan drafts expose edit, pause, stop, archive, delete, export, share, and revoke-memory controls; accountability sharing requires explicit audience selection and links to /contracts; health, sleep, social, calendar, and contract evidence can be removed from a single plan without deleting the whole plan; locked previews never reveal personalized health/social insight until both consent and entitlement are granted. Fonts: Hanken Grotesk (UI) + Newsreader Medium Italic (emphasis word), standing in for Neue Montreal/Tiempos per session waiver W-FONT-01. PlanCard (NEW) promotes to catalog per the screen-43 PaywallLock precedent — reusable across any future plan-list surface.

modules.build: iOS status bar: time left, signal/wifi/battery right, paper-100 icons on #0A0A0F warm-dark shell with top-center orange radial atmosphere (18%) and grain. Fixed 44px, no copy.

TopBar, transparent over atmosphere: H1 "Plans" left-aligned. Trailing: draft-plan glyph action (44px target, opens CIA draft sheet) + filter glyph action (44px target, opens plan filters sheet). No back chevron — Goals-tab root screen.

GlassCard.hero (r40, glow-you orange; NEW ActivePlanPath). Overline "Active plan", H3 "Half marathon base", Caption "Week 3 of 8". Milestone spine: start / wk3 current / 5K tempo next / wk8, 8px ProgressBar 37% orange fill. Caption "Next *right* step" then "Tomorrow · 6:30 AM", ChipProvenance "via training plan sync". BtnPrimary "Resume plan" + BtnCoach "Adjust with CIA".

CIAInsightCard (glow-cia purple, spark glyph): "Your sleep suggests moving the hard run one day later." ChipProvenance "via sleep + training plan" beneath. Opt-in only — no auto-apply. Trailing BtnGhost "Review" chevron opens an adjustment sheet naming data used before any change lands on the active plan.

SegmentedTabs (glass pill track, 44px targets): "All" · "Active" · "Completed" · "Paused". Default selected "All" (surface-3 fill + orange label). 150ms slide indicator; list content crossfades beneath on switch; reduced motion swaps instantly.

SolidCard list (--surface-2, scan density), 3x PlanCard/ListRow (NEW, 56px min, hairline dividers): "Strength reset" · ChipDomainTag Fitness · "4 wks" · ChipProvenance "via CIA" · chevron. "Budget cleanup" · ChipDomainTag Finance · PaywallLock inline (blurred preview + BtnPrimary "Unlock with premium") · "locked template". "Evening wind-down" · ChipDomainTag Wellbeing · ChipProvenance "you saved" · chevron.

GlassNavBar (floating glass pill, fixed, 16px above HomeIndicator): Today · CIA · Goals · Me — active tab "Goals" (orange filled icon + label), others outline paper-64%. Content scrolls beneath with fade. HomeIndicator anchors screen base.
